topline.text: Another quiet 24-48 hours nationally - no major new DfE, Ofsted, behaviour, safeguarding or funding stories broke overnight, and nothing fresh has surfaced from Sheffield or South Yorkshire either.

The one thing to flag: ONS publishes its quarterly NEET (not in education, employment or training) statistics for the UK this morning (26 Nov, 9:30am) - figures weren't yet published at the time of writing, so check the ONS release directly for today's number.

box.text: young people aged 16-24 in the UK were NEET in April-June 2026 (13.0%) - the last confirmed ONS figure, up 30,000 on a year earlier. Today's newer quarter figure is due but unconfirmed at time of writing.
